title: Vegetable Oils
description: Global supply of vegetable oils including sunflower, soybean, palm, and canola oil for food processing, industrial applications, and international commodity markets.
overview:
AFGT coordinates the supply of vegetable oils for international buyers across food manufacturing, industrial processing, and distribution markets. The company works with certified refineries and established exporters across major global oilseed producing regions.

Through structured commodity trading workflows, AFGT supports buyers with sourcing alignment, shipment planning, and documentation coordination for vegetable oil supply across global trade corridors.

specifications.label: Product Types
specifications.value: Sunflower oil, soybean oil, palm oil, canola oil, and corn oil supplied in crude and refined grades depending on buyer specifications.

specifications.label: Packaging
specifications.value: Bulk vessels, flexitank containers, ISO tanks, and bottled formats depending on destination market requirements.

specifications.label: Contract Terms
specifications.value: FOB, CFR, and CIF shipment structures aligned with international commodity trading standards.

specifications.label: Quality Standards
specifications.value: Food-grade vegetable oils compliant with Codex Alimentarius standards and international refinery quality controls.

certifications: Food-grade vegetable oils compliant with Codex Alimentarius standards and international refinery quality controls.
